def pathology_to_label(x):
    s = str(x).lower()
    if "malignant" in s:
        return 1
    if "benign" in s:
        return 0
    return np.nan

device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
print("Device:", device)

BATCH = 8  # CPU-safe; if GPU you can set 16/32

# --- helpers ---
def load_rgb(path):
    img = Image.open(path)
    if img.mode != "RGB":
        img = img.convert("RGB")
    return img

@torch.no_grad()
def extract_timm_feats(df_part, model, tfm, batch=BATCH):
    model.eval()
    paths = df_part["img_full"].tolist()
    feats = []

    for i in tqdm(range(0, len(paths), batch), desc="timm-feats"):
        batch_paths = paths[i:i+batch]
        x = torch.stack([tfm(load_rgb(p)) for p in batch_paths]).to(device)
        f = model(x).detach().cpu().numpy()
        feats.append(f)

    return np.vstack(feats)

@torch.no_grad()
def extract_clip_feats(df_part, clip_model, clip_preprocess, batch=BATCH):
    clip_model.eval()
    paths = df_part["img_full"].tolist()
    feats = []

    for i in tqdm(range(0, len(paths), batch), desc="clip-feats"):
        batch_paths = paths[i:i+batch]
        x = torch.stack([clip_preprocess(load_rgb(p)) for p in batch_paths]).to(device)
        f = clip_model.encode_image(x)
        f = f / f.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        feats.append(f.detach().cpu().numpy())

    return np.vstack(feats)

# --- CNN (EfficientNet-B0 features) ---
cnn = timm.create_model("tf_efficientnet_b3", pretrained=True, num_classes=0).to(device)
cnn_cfg = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(cnn)
cnn_tfm = timm.data.create_transform(**cnn_cfg, is_training=False)

# --- ViT features ---
vit = timm.create_model("vit_base_patch16_224", pretrained=True, num_classes=0).to(device)
vit_cfg = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(vit)
vit_tfm = timm.data.create_transform(**vit_cfg, is_training=False)

# --- CLIP features ---
clip_model, _, clip_preprocess = open_clip.create_model_and_transforms("ViT-B-16", pretrained="openai")
clip_model = clip_model.to(device)

# Extract
Xtr_cnn  = extract_timm_feats(df_train, cnn, cnn_tfm)
Xva_cnn  = extract_timm_feats(df_val,   cnn, cnn_tfm)
Xte_cnn  = extract_timm_feats(df_test,  cnn, cnn_tfm)

Xtr_vit  = extract_timm_feats(df_train, vit, vit_tfm)
Xva_vit  = extract_timm_feats(df_val,   vit, vit_tfm)
Xte_vit  = extract_timm_feats(df_test,  vit, vit_tfm)

Xtr_clip = extract_clip_feats(df_train, clip_model, clip_preprocess)
Xva_clip = extract_clip_feats(df_val,   clip_model, clip_preprocess)
Xte_clip = extract_clip_feats(df_test,  clip_model, clip_preprocess)

ytr = df_train["label_bin"].to_numpy()
yva = df_val["label_bin"].to_numpy()
yte = df_test["label_bin"].to_numpy()

print("Shapes:")
print("CNN :", Xtr_cnn.shape, Xva_cnn.shape, Xte_cnn.shape)
print("ViT :", Xtr_vit.shape, Xva_vit.shape, Xte_vit.shape)
print("CLIP:", Xtr_clip.shape, Xva_clip.shape, Xte_clip.shape)

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=2500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=SEED
)

rf.fit(Xtr, ytr)

# --- pick threshold on VAL by max Youden J (sens + spec - 1) ---
pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]

ths = np.linspace(0.05, 0.95, 91)
best = None

for t in ths:
    pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)
    j = sens + spec - 1
    if best is None or j > best["j"]:
        best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "j": float(j)}

print("Best threshold (VAL):", best)

def eval_at(name, X, y, thr):
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    print(f"\n== {name} @ thr={thr:.2f} ==")
    print("AUC :", roc_auc_score(y, prob))
    print("ACC :", accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("PREC:", precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("REC :", recall_score(y, pred, zero_division=0), "(Sensitivity)")
    print("SPEC:", spec)
    print("F1  :", f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("CM:\n", cm)
    print("\nReport:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

eval_at("VAL",  Xva, yva, best["t"])
eval_at("TEST", Xte, yte, best["t"])

from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, balanced_accuracy_score
)

def eval_at(name, X, y, thr):
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0, 1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    # Core screening metrics
    sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)   # TPR, Recall for malignant (class 1)
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)   # TNR, Recall for benign (class 0)

    # Extra helpful medical metrics
    ppv = tp / (tp + fp + 1e-12)           # Positive Predictive Value (Precision)
    npv = tn / (tn + fn + 1e-12)           # Negative Predictive Value

    auc  = roc_auc_score(y, prob)
    acc  = accuracy_score(y, pred)
    bacc = balanced_accuracy_score(y, pred)
    f1   = f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)

    print(f"\n== {name} @ thr={thr:.2f} ==")
    print(f"AUC        : {auc:.4f}")
    print(f"Accuracy   : {acc:.4f}")
    print(f"Bal-Acc    : {bacc:.4f}")
    print(f"Sensitivity: {sensitivity:.4f}  (TPR, malignant recall)")
    print(f"Specificity: {specificity:.4f}  (TNR, benign recall)")
    print(f"PPV (Prec) : {ppv:.4f}")
    print(f"NPV        : {npv:.4f}")
    print(f"F1         : {f1:.4f}")
    print("Confusion Matrix [ [TN FP] [FN TP] ]:")
    print(cm)

# Use your best threshold
eval_at("VAL",  Xva, yva, best["t"])
eval_at("TEST", Xte, yte, best["t"])

# ✅ CELL 7 — Side-by-side evaluation plots (publication friendly)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import (
    roc_curve, auc,
    precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score,
    confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
)

thr = best["t"]


def plot_all(name, X, y, thr):

    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

    prec, rec, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0, 1])

    # 🔥 4 plots side-by-side
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(22, 5))

    # --- ROC ---
    axes[0].plot(fpr, tpr)
    axes[0].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--")
    axes[0].set_title(f"{name} ROC\nAUC={roc_auc:.3f}")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("FPR")
    axes[0].set_ylabel("TPR")

    # --- PR ---
    axes[1].plot(rec, prec)
    axes[1].set_title(f"{name} PR\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Recall")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Precision")

    # --- Confusion matrix ---
    disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(cm, display_labels=["Benign", "Malignant"])
    disp.plot(ax=axes[2], values_format="d", colorbar=False)
    axes[2].set_title("Confusion Matrix")

    # --- Probability histogram ---
    axes[3].hist(prob[y == 0], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Benign")
    axes[3].hist(prob[y == 1], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant")
    axes[3].axvline(thr, linestyle="--")
    axes[3].set_title("Score Distribution")
    axes[3].legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()


# Run
plot_all("VAL", Xva, yva, thr)
plot_all("TEST", Xte, yte, thr)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    precision_score, f1_score, classification_report
)

# 1) Concatenate features
Xtr = np.concatenate([Xtr_cnn, Xtr_vit, Xtr_clip], axis=1)
Xva = np.concatenate([Xva_cnn, Xva_vit, Xva_clip], axis=1)
Xte = np.concatenate([Xte_cnn, Xte_vit, Xte_clip], axis=1)
print("Concat shapes:", Xtr.shape, Xva.shape, Xte.shape)

# 2) Train RF
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=2500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=SEED
)
rf.fit(Xtr, ytr)

# ✅ 3) FIXED threshold (as you told)
thr = 0.34
print("Using FIXED threshold:", thr)

# 4) Evaluation function
def eval_at(name, X, y, thr):
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    print(f"\n== {name} @ thr={thr:.2f} ==")
    print("AUC :", roc_auc_score(y, prob))
    print("ACC :", accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("PREC:", precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("SENS:", sens, "(Sensitivity)")
    print("SPEC:", spec, "(Specificity)")
    print("F1  :", f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Confusion Matrix [ [TN FP] [FN TP] ]:\n", cm)
    print("\nReport:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    return prob, pred, cm

# Run evaluation
pva, yva_pred, cm_va = eval_at("VAL",  Xva, yva, thr)
pte, yte_pred, cm_te = eval_at("TEST", Xte, yte, thr)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    precision_score, f1_score, classification_report,
    roc_curve, precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Concatenate features
# -----------------------------
Xtr = np.concatenate([Xtr_cnn, Xtr_vit, Xtr_clip], axis=1)
Xva = np.concatenate([Xva_cnn, Xva_vit, Xva_clip], axis=1)
Xte = np.concatenate([Xte_cnn, Xte_vit, Xte_clip], axis=1)
print("Concat shapes:", Xtr.shape, Xva.shape, Xte.shape)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Train RF
# -----------------------------
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=2500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=SEED
)
rf.fit(Xtr, ytr)

# ✅ 3) FIXED threshold (as you told)
thr = 0.34
print("Using FIXED threshold:", thr)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Evaluation + return for plotting
# -----------------------------
def eval_at(name, X, y, thr):
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    print(f"\n== {name} @ thr={thr:.2f} ==")
    print("AUC :", roc_auc_score(y, prob))
    print("ACC :", accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("PREC:", precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("SENS:", sens, "(Sensitivity)")
    print("SPEC:", spec, "(Specificity)")
    print("F1  :", f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Confusion Matrix [ [TN FP] [FN TP] ]:\n", cm)
    print("\nReport:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    return prob, pred, cm, (tn, fp, fn, tp), sens, spec

# Run evaluation
pva, yva_pred, cm_va, counts_va, sens_va, spec_va = eval_at("VAL",  Xva, yva, thr)
pte, yte_pred, cm_te, counts_te, sens_te, spec_te = eval_at("TEST", Xte, yte, thr)

# -----------------------------
# 5) Visualization helpers
# -----------------------------
def plot_confusion(ax, cm, title):
    ax.imshow(cm)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted")
    ax.set_ylabel("True")
    ax.set_xticks([0, 1]); ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_xticklabels(["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"])
    ax.set_yticklabels(["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"])
    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        ax.text(j, i, str(v), ha="center", va="center")

def plot_score_dist(ax, prob, y, thr, title, bins=25):
    ax.hist(prob[y == 0], bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label="Benign (0)")
    ax.hist(prob[y == 1], bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant (1)")
    ax.axvline(thr, linestyle="--", label=f"thr={thr:.2f}")
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted P(class=1)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.legend()

def plot_roc(ax, y, prob, title):
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y, prob)
    ax.plot(fpr, tpr)
    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--")
    ax.set_title(f"{title}\nAUC={auc:.3f}")
    ax.set_xlabel("FPR")
    ax.set_ylabel("TPR")

def plot_pr(ax, y, prob, title):
    prec, rec, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)
    ax.plot(rec, prec)
    ax.set_title(f"{title}\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Recall")
    ax.set_ylabel("Precision")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)

def plot_sens_spec_vs_thr(ax, y, prob, thr_fixed, title):
    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, 99)
    sens_list, spec_list = [], []
    for t in ths:
        pred = (prob >= t).astype(int)
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
        sens_list.append(tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12))
        spec_list.append(tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12))

    ax.plot(ths, sens_list, label="Sensitivity")
    ax.plot(ths, spec_list, label="Specificity")
    ax.axvline(thr_fixed, linestyle="--", label=f"thr={thr_fixed:.2f}")
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Threshold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.legend()

# -----------------------------
# 6) Make plots (VAL row + TEST row)
# -----------------------------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(22, 7))

# VAL plots
plot_roc(axes[0,0], yva, pva, "VAL ROC")
plot_pr(axes[0,1], yva, pva, "VAL PR")
plot_confusion(axes[0,2], cm_va, "VAL Confusion")
plot_score_dist(axes[0,3], pva, yva, thr, "VAL Score Distribution")
plot_sens_spec_vs_thr(axes[0,4], yva, pva, thr, "VAL Sens/Spec vs Threshold")

# TEST plots
plot_roc(axes[1,0], yte, pte, "TEST ROC")
plot_pr(axes[1,1], yte, pte, "TEST PR")
plot_confusion(axes[1,2], cm_te, "TEST Confusion")
plot_score_dist(axes[1,3], pte, yte, thr, "TEST Score Distribution")
plot_sens_spec_vs_thr(axes[1,4], yte, pte, thr, "TEST Sens/Spec vs Threshold")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# -----------------------------
# 7) Interpretation: "Is cancer detected?"
# -----------------------------
def interpret_counts(name, counts, sens, spec):
    tn, fp, fn, tp = counts
    print(f"\n--- Interpretation ({name}) ---")
    print(f"Detected cancers (TP): {tp}")
    print(f"Missed cancers (FN):   {fn}")
    print(f"Correct benign (TN):   {tn}")
    print(f"False alarms (FP):     {fp}")
    print(f"Sensitivity (cancer detection rate): {sens:.3f}")
    print(f"Specificity (benign rejection rate): {spec:.3f}")

interpret_counts("VAL",  counts_va, sens_va, spec_va)
interpret_counts("TEST", counts_te, sens_te, spec_te)

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    precision_score, f1_score, classification_report
)

# 1) Concatenate features
Xtr = np.concatenate([Xtr_cnn, Xtr_vit, Xtr_clip], axis=1)
Xva = np.concatenate([Xva_cnn, Xva_vit, Xva_clip], axis=1)
Xte = np.concatenate([Xte_cnn, Xte_vit, Xte_clip], axis=1)
print("Concat shapes:", Xtr.shape, Xva.shape, Xte.shape)

# 2) Train RF
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=2500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=SEED
)
rf.fit(Xtr, ytr)

# -----------------------------
# Choose threshold on VAL for Sensitivity >= 0.80
# -----------------------------
target_sens = 0.80

pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, 991)   # finer grid

best = None
for t in ths:

    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    # keep thresholds that meet sensitivity target, then maximize specificity
    if sens >= target_sens:
        if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
            best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn)}

if best is None:

    print("Confusion Matrix [ [TN FP] [FN TP] ]:\n", cm)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    precision_score, f1_score, classification_report,
    roc_curve, precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
)

# 1) Concatenate features
Xtr = np.concatenate([Xtr_cnn, Xtr_vit, Xtr_clip], axis=1)
Xva = np.concatenate([Xva_cnn, Xva_vit, Xva_clip], axis=1)
Xte = np.concatenate([Xte_cnn, Xte_vit, Xte_clip], axis=1)
print("Concat shapes:", Xtr.shape, Xva.shape, Xte.shape)

# 2) Train RF
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=2500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=SEED
)
rf.fit(Xtr, ytr)

# 3) Pick threshold on VAL to INCREASE sensitivity
pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
ths = np.linspace(0.05, 0.95, 181)

target_sens = 0.70  # try 0.70 first, then 0.75
best = None

for t in ths:
    pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    if sens >= target_sens:
        if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
            best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn)}

if best is None:
    print(f"No threshold meets target_sens={target_sens:.2f} on VAL.")
    print("Try target_sens = 0.65 or 0.60")
    best = {"t": 0.41}
else:
    print("Chosen threshold for higher sensitivity (VAL):", best)

thr = best["t"]

# ---------- Visualization helpers ----------
def _plot_confusion(ax, cm, title="Confusion Matrix", class_names=("Benign","Malignant")):
    ax.imshow(cm)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted label")
    ax.set_ylabel("True label")
    ax.set_xticks([0, 1]); ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_xticklabels(class_names); ax.set_yticklabels(class_names)

    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        ax.text(j, i, str(v), ha="center", va="center")

def _plot_score_dist(ax, prob, y, thr, title="Score Distribution", bins=25):
    prob0 = prob[y == 0]
    prob1 = prob[y == 1]
    ax.hist(prob0, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label="Benign")
    ax.hist(prob1, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant")
    ax.axvline(thr, linestyle="--")
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted probability (class=1)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.legend()

def _plot_row(axs, name, y, prob, pred, thr):
    # ROC
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y, prob)
    axs[0].plot(fpr, tpr)
    axs[0].plot([0,1], [0,1], linestyle="--")
    axs[0].set_title(f"{name} ROC\nAUC={auc:.3f}")
    axs[0].set_xlabel("FPR")
    axs[0].set_ylabel("TPR")

    # PR
    prec, rec, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)
    axs[1].plot(rec, prec)
    axs[1].set_title(f"{name} PR\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("Recall")
    axs[1].set_ylabel("Precision")
    axs[1].set_xlim(0, 1)
    axs[1].set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Confusion
    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    _plot_confusion(axs[2], cm, title="Confusion Matrix")

    # Score dist
    _plot_score_dist(axs[3], prob, y, thr, title="Score Distribution")


# 4) Evaluation function (prints) + returns arrays for plotting
def eval_at(name, X, y, thr):
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    print(f"\n== {name} @ thr={thr:.2f} ==")
    print("AUC :", roc_auc_score(y, prob))
    print("ACC :", accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("PREC:", precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("SENS:", sens, "(Sensitivity)")
    print("SPEC:", spec)
    print("F1  :", f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Confusion Matrix [ [TN FP] [FN TP] ]:\n", cm)
    print("\nReport:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    return prob, pred  # <-- for visualization


# ---- Run evaluation + collect arrays ----
pva, yva_pred = eval_at("VAL",  Xva, yva, thr)
pte, yte_pred = eval_at("TEST", Xte, yte, thr)

# ---- Visualization (2 rows x 4 cols) ----
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 4, figsize=(18, 7))
_plot_row(axes[0], "VAL",  yva, pva, yva_pred, thr)
_plot_row(axes[1], "TEST", yte, pte, yte_pred, thr)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

df_all = df.copy()   # your full dataframe

IMG_COL = "img_full"     # ← your image path column (from earlier steps)
Y_COL   = "label"
PID_COL = "patient_id"

print("Total rows:", len(df_all))

# -------------------------
# TEST split (20%)
# -------------------------
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(test_size=0.20, random_state=42)

trainval_idx, test_idx = next(gss.split(df_all, groups=df_all[PID_COL]))

trainval_df = df_all.iloc[trainval_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
test_df     = df_all.iloc[test_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

# -------------------------
# VAL split (20% of remaining)
# -------------------------
gss2 = GroupShuffleSplit(test_size=0.20, random_state=42)

train_idx, val_idx = next(gss2.split(trainval_df, groups=trainval_df[PID_COL]))

train_df = trainval_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_df   = trainval_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

print("Train:", train_df.shape)
print("Val  :", val_df.shape)
print("Test :", test_df.shape)

# sanity check (NO leakage)
print("Overlap patients:",

import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms
from PIL import Image

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print("Device:", device)

class ImgDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_col, y_col, tfm):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_col = img_col
        self.y_col = y_col
        self.tfm = tfm

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, i):
        p = self.df.loc[i, self.img_col]
        y = int(self.df.loc[i, self.y_col])
        img = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
        img = self.tfm(img)
        return img, y

tfm = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize((224,224)),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize(mean=(0.5,0.5,0.5), std=(0.5,0.5,0.5)),
])

BATCH = 8
train_loader = DataLoader(ImgDataset(train_df, IMG_COL, Y_COL, tfm), batch_size=BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
val_loader   = DataLoader(ImgDataset(val_df,   IMG_COL, Y_COL, tfm), batch_size=BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
test_loader  = DataLoader(ImgDataset(test_df,  IMG_COL, Y_COL, tfm), batch_size=BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

print("Loaders:", len(train_loader), len(val_loader), len(test_loader))

import torch.nn as nn
from torchvision.models import resnet50, ResNet50_Weights

class ResNet50Feat(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        m = resnet50(weights=ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V2)
        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*list(m.children())[:-1])  # remove FC layer
    def forward(self, x):
        f = self.backbone(x)   # [B,2048,1,1]
        return f.flatten(1)    # [B,2048]

cnn = ResNet50Feat().to(device).eval()
print("ResNet50 feature extractor ready ✅")

import numpy as np
import torch

@torch.no_grad()
def extract_feats(model, loader, name="feats"):
    X_list, y_list = [], []
    for xb, yb in loader:
        xb = xb.to(device)
        f = model(xb).detach().cpu().numpy()
        X_list.append(f)
        y_list.append(yb.numpy())
    X = np.concatenate(X_list, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(y_list, axis=0)
    print(f"{name}: X={X.shape} y={y.shape}")
    return X, y

import open_clip
import torch
import numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

clip_model, _, clip_pre = open_clip.create_model_and_transforms("ViT-B-32", pretrained="openai")
clip_model = clip_model.to(device).eval()
print("CLIP ready ✅")

# CLIP uses its own preprocessing, so make CLIP loaders
train_loader_clip = DataLoader(ImgDataset(train_df, IMG_COL, Y_COL, clip_pre), batch_size=BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
val_loader_clip   = DataLoader(ImgDataset(val_df,   IMG_COL, Y_COL, clip_pre), batch_size=BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
test_loader_clip  = DataLoader(ImgDataset(test_df,  IMG_COL, Y_COL, clip_pre), batch_size=BATCH, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

@torch.no_grad()
def extract_clip(model, loader, name="clip"):
    X_list, y_list = [], []
    for xb, yb in loader:
        xb = xb.to(device)
        f = model.encode_image(xb)
        f = f / (f.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-12)  # normalize CLIP embedding
        X_list.append(f.detach().cpu().numpy())
        y_list.append(yb.numpy())
    X = np.concatenate(X_list, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(y_list, axis=0)
    print(f"{name}: X={X.shape} y={y.shape}")
    return X, y

Xtr_clip, _ = extract_clip(clip_model, train_loader_clip, "CLIP train")
Xva_clip, _ = extract_clip(clip_model, val_loader_clip,   "CLIP val")
Xte_clip, _ = extract_clip(clip_model, test_loader_clip,  "CLIP test")

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

def choose_thr_val_buffer(rf, Xva, yva, target_test_sens=0.80, buffer=0.05, grid_n=2000):
    """
    Choose threshold on VAL so that VAL sensitivity >= target_test_sens + buffer.
    Then among those thresholds, maximize specificity.
    """
    target_val_sens = min(0.99, target_test_sens + buffer)

    if Xva.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(f"Feature mismatch: Xva {Xva.shape[1]} vs rf {rf.n_features_in_}")

    pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, grid_n)

    best = None
    for t in ths:
        pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
        sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
        spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

        if sens >= target_val_sens:
            if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
                best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn)}

    if best is None:
        print(f"⚠️ Could not reach VAL sens >= {target_val_sens:.2f}. Lower buffer or target.")
        # fallback: maximum sensitivity threshold
        best2 = None
        for t in ths:
            pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
            tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
            sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
            spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
            if best2 is None or sens > best2["sens"]:
                best2 = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec)}
        print("Using max-sensitivity threshold on VAL:", best2)
        return best2["t"]

    print(f"✅ Chosen threshold on VAL (buffered): target_val_sens={target_val_sens:.2f}")
    print(best)
    return best["t"]

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, classification_report,
    roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    precision_score, f1_score,
    roc_curve, precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
)

# -----------------------------
# Evaluation + Plots
# -----------------------------
def evaluate_and_plot(name, rf, X, y, thr):
    # feature safety check
    if X.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name}: X has {X.shape[1]} features but RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}. "
            "Use same PCA/non-PCA features for rf.fit() and for X."
        )

    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

    auc = roc_auc_score(y, prob)
    acc = accuracy_score(y, pred)
    prec = precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)
    f1 = f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)

    # ---- print metrics ----
    print("\n" + "="*70)
    print(f"{name} @ thr={thr:.3f}")
    print("="*70)
    print(f"AUC        : {auc:.4f}")
    print(f"Accuracy   : {acc:.4f}")
    print(f"Precision  : {prec:.4f}")
    print(f"Sensitivity: {sens:.4f}")
    print(f"Specificity: {spec:.4f}")
    print(f"F1         : {f1:.4f}")
    print(f"TN FP FN TP: {tn} {fp} {fn} {tp}")
    print("\nConfusion Matrix [[TN FP] [FN TP]]:\n", cm)
    print("\nReport:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    # ---- plots ----
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(18, 4))

    # ROC
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    axs[0].plot(fpr, tpr)
    axs[0].plot([0,1], [0,1], linestyle="--")
    axs[0].set_title(f"{name} ROC\nAUC={auc:.3f}")
    axs[0].set_xlabel("FPR")
    axs[0].set_ylabel("TPR")

    # PR
    p, r, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    axs[1].plot(r, p)
    axs[1].set_title(f"{name} PR\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("Recall")
    axs[1].set_ylabel("Precision")
    axs[1].set_xlim(0, 1)
    axs[1].set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Confusion matrix
    axs[2].imshow(cm)
    axs[2].set_title("Confusion Matrix")
    axs[2].set_xticks([0,1]); axs[2].set_yticks([0,1])
    axs[2].set_xticklabels(["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"])
    axs[2].set_yticklabels(["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"])
    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        axs[2].text(j, i, str(v), ha="center", va="center")

    # Score distribution
    axs[3].hist(prob[y==0], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Benign (0)")
    axs[3].hist(prob[y==1], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant (1)")
    axs[3].axvline(thr, linestyle="--", label=f"thr={thr:.3f}")
    axs[3].set_title("Score Distribution")
    axs[3].set_xlabel("Predicted P(class=1)")
    axs[3].set_ylabel("Count")
    axs[3].legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return {"AUC": auc, "ACC": acc, "PREC": prec, "SENS": sens, "SPEC": spec, "F1": f1,
            "TN": tn, "FP": fp, "FN": fn, "TP": tp}

# -----------------------------
# Run threshold selection on VAL
# -----------------------------
thr = choose_thr_val_buffer(rf, Xva, yva, target_test_sens=0.80, buffer=0.05)
print("Final threshold chosen on VAL:", thr)

# -----------------------------
# Evaluate on VAL and TEST
# -----------------------------
val_stats  = evaluate_and_plot("VAL",  rf, Xva, yva, thr)
test_stats = evaluate_and_plot("TEST", rf, Xte, yte, thr)

print("\nVAL stats :", val_stats)
print("TEST stats:", test_stats)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, precision_score, f1_score

def pick_threshold_in_band(rf, Xva, yva,
                           sens_lo=0.70, sens_hi=0.80,
                           spec_lo=0.50, spec_hi=0.60,
                           grid_n=4000,
                           choose="acc"):
    """
    Pick threshold on VAL that falls in both sensitivity and specificity bands.
    choose: "acc" (default), "f1", or "youden"
    """
    if Xva.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(f"Feature mismatch: Xva {Xva.shape[1]} vs rf {rf.n_features_in_}")

    pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, grid_n)

    best = None
    rows = []

    for t in ths:
        pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

        sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
        spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
        acc  = (tp+tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn+1e-12)

        prec = tp/(tp+fp+1e-12)
        f1   = 2*prec*sens/(prec+sens+1e-12)
        youden = sens + spec - 1

        rows.append((t, sens, spec, acc, prec, f1, youden, fp, fn))

        in_band = (sens_lo <= sens <= sens_hi) and (spec_lo <= spec <= spec_hi)
        if in_band:
            score = {"acc": acc, "f1": f1, "youden": youden}[choose]
            if best is None or score > best["score"]:
                best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec),
                        "acc": float(acc), "prec": float(prec), "f1": float(f1),
                        "youden": float(youden), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn),
                        "score": float(score)}

    if best is None:
        # fallback: closest to the center of your desired bands
        target_sens = (sens_lo + sens_hi)/2
        target_spec = (spec_lo + spec_hi)/2
        best2 = min(rows, key=lambda r: abs(r[1]-target_sens) + abs(r[2]-target_spec))
        t, sens, spec, acc, prec, f1, youden, fp, fn = best2
        print("⚠️ No threshold hit BOTH bands exactly on VAL. Using closest-to-band threshold.")
        best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec),
                "acc": float(acc), "prec": float(prec), "f1": float(f1),
                "youden": float(youden), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn), "score": None}

    print("\n✅ Chosen threshold on VAL (band-constrained):")
    print({k: best[k] for k in ["t","sens","spec","acc","prec","f1","fp","fn"]})
    return best["t"]

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, classification_report,
    roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, precision_score, f1_score,
    roc_curve, precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Pick threshold in desired band on VAL
# -----------------------------
def pick_threshold_in_band(rf, Xva, yva,
                           sens_lo=0.70, sens_hi=0.80,
                           spec_lo=0.50, spec_hi=0.60,
                           grid_n=4000,
                           choose="acc"):
    if Xva.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Feature mismatch: Xva has {Xva.shape[1]} features but RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}. "
            "Make sure rf was trained on the same Xtr feature space (PCA vs non-PCA)."
        )

    pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, grid_n)

    best = None
    rows = []

    for t in ths:
        pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

        sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
        spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
        acc  = (tp+tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn+1e-12)
        prec = tp/(tp+fp+1e-12)
        f1   = 2*prec*sens/(prec+sens+1e-12)
        youden = sens + spec - 1

        rows.append((t, sens, spec, acc, prec, f1, youden, fp, fn))

        in_band = (sens_lo <= sens <= sens_hi) and (spec_lo <= spec <= spec_hi)
        if in_band:
            score = {"acc": acc, "f1": f1, "youden": youden}[choose]
            if best is None or score > best["score"]:
                best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec),
                        "acc": float(acc), "prec": float(prec), "f1": float(f1),
                        "youden": float(youden), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn),
                        "score": float(score)}

    if best is None:
        # fallback: closest to middle of bands
        target_sens = (sens_lo + sens_hi)/2
        target_spec = (spec_lo + spec_hi)/2
        t, sens, spec, acc, prec, f1, youden, fp, fn = min(
            rows, key=lambda r: abs(r[1]-target_sens) + abs(r[2]-target_spec)
        )
        print("⚠️ No threshold hit BOTH bands exactly on VAL. Using closest-to-band threshold.")
        best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec),
                "acc": float(acc), "prec": float(prec), "f1": float(f1),
                "youden": float(youden), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn),
                "score": None}

    print("\n✅ Chosen threshold on VAL:")
    print({k: best[k] for k in ["t","sens","spec","acc","prec","f1","fp","fn"]})
    return best["t"]


# -----------------------------
# 2) Evaluation metrics + plots
# -----------------------------
def evaluate_metrics_and_plots(name, rf, X, y, thr):
    if X.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name}: X has {X.shape[1]} features but RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}."
        )

    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

    auc = roc_auc_score(y, prob)
    acc = accuracy_score(y, pred)
    prec = precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)
    f1 = f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)

    print("\n" + "="*70)
    print(f"{name} @ thr={thr:.3f}")
    print("="*70)
    print(f"AUC        : {auc:.4f}")
    print(f"Accuracy   : {acc:.4f}")
    print(f"Precision  : {prec:.4f}")
    print(f"Sensitivity: {sens:.4f}")
    print(f"Specificity: {spec:.4f}")
    print(f"F1         : {f1:.4f}")
    print(f"TN FP FN TP: {tn} {fp} {fn} {tp}")
    print("\nConfusion Matrix [[TN FP] [FN TP]]:\n", cm)
    print("\nReport:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(18, 4))

    # ROC
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    axs[0].plot(fpr, tpr)
    axs[0].plot([0,1], [0,1], linestyle="--")
    axs[0].set_title(f"{name} ROC\nAUC={auc:.3f}")
    axs[0].set_xlabel("FPR")
    axs[0].set_ylabel("TPR")

    # PR
    p, r, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    axs[1].plot(r, p)
    axs[1].set_title(f"{name} PR\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("Recall")
    axs[1].set_ylabel("Precision")
    axs[1].set_xlim(0, 1)
    axs[1].set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Confusion
    axs[2].imshow(cm)
    axs[2].set_title("Confusion Matrix")
    axs[2].set_xticks([0,1]); axs[2].set_yticks([0,1])
    axs[2].set_xticklabels(["Benign (0)","Malignant (1)"])
    axs[2].set_yticklabels(["Benign (0)","Malignant (1)"])
    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        axs[2].text(j, i, str(v), ha="center", va="center")

    # Score dist
    axs[3].hist(prob[y==0], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Benign (0)")
    axs[3].hist(prob[y==1], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant (1)")
    axs[3].axvline(thr, linestyle="--", label=f"thr={thr:.3f}")
    axs[3].set_title("Score Distribution")
    axs[3].legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return {"AUC": auc, "ACC": acc, "PREC": prec, "SENS": sens, "SPEC": spec, "F1": f1,
            "TN": tn, "FP": fp, "FN": fn, "TP": tp}


# -----------------------------
# 3) Run selection + evaluation
# -----------------------------
print("Xva features:", Xva.shape[1], " | RF expects:", rf.n_features_in_)

thr = pick_threshold_in_band(
    rf, Xva, yva,
    sens_lo=0.70, sens_hi=0.80,
    spec_lo=0.50, spec_hi=0.60,
    choose="acc"
)

val_stats  = evaluate_metrics_and_plots("VAL",  rf, Xva, yva, thr)
test_stats = evaluate_metrics_and_plots("TEST", rf, Xte, yte, thr)

print("\nChosen threshold:", thr)
print("VAL stats :", val_stats)
print("TEST stats:", test_stats)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

def find_best_threshold(rf, Xval, yval, target_sens=0.80):
    """
    Choose threshold that:
    1) achieves sensitivity >= target_sens
    2) among them maximizes specificity
    """

    # safety check (prevents your previous error)
    assert Xval.shape[1] == rf.n_features_in_, \
        f"Feature mismatch: X has {Xval.shape[1]}, RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}"

    prob = rf.predict_proba(Xval)[:, 1]

    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, 991)
    best = None

    for t in ths:
        pred = (prob >= t).astype(int)

        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yval, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

        sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
        spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

        if sens >= target_sens:
            if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
                best = {
                    "threshold": float(t),
                    "sens": float(sens),
                    "spec": float(spec),
                    "fp": int(fp),
                    "fn": int(fn)
                }

    # fallback if not reachable
    if best is None:
        print("⚠️ Target sensitivity not reachable. Using default 0.5")
        return 0.5

    print("\n✅ Best threshold found:")
    print(best)

    return best["threshold"]

        if (best is None) or (spec > best["spec"]) or (spec == best["spec"] and j > best["j"]):
            best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "j": float(j)}

thr = best["t"]

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

# ============================================================
# Best-threshold chooser (VAL only, screening-oriented)
# - First satisfy target sensitivity
# - Then maximize specificity (reduce false positives)
# ============================================================
def choose_best_threshold(rf, Xva, yva, target_sens=0.80, grid_n=991):
    # Safety check to avoid your "472 vs 3328" error
    if Xva.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Feature mismatch: Xva has {Xva.shape[1]} features, "
            f"but RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}. "
            f"Use the SAME features (PCA/non-PCA) for rf.fit() and Xva."
        )

    pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, grid_n)

    best = None
    for t in ths:
        pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

        sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
        spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

        if sens >= target_sens:
            if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
                best = {
                    "t": float(t),
                    "sens": float(sens),
                    "spec": float(spec),
                    "tn": int(tn), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn), "tp": int(tp)
                }

    if best is None:
        # fallback: pick threshold with maximum sensitivity
        best2 = None
        for t in ths:
            pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
            tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
            sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)
            spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)
            if best2 is None or sens > best2["sens"]:
                best2 = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec)}
        print(f"⚠️ target_sens={target_sens} not reached. Using max-sensitivity threshold:", best2)
        return best2["t"]

    print("✅ Best threshold (VAL):", best)
    return best["t"]

# ============================================================
# USE IT (after rf.fit(Xtr, ytr))
# ============================================================
thr = choose_best_threshold(rf, Xva, yva, target_sens=0.80)
print("Final threshold:", thr)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, classification_report,
    roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, precision_score, f1_score,
    roc_curve, precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
)

# ============================================================
# Evaluation + Visualization (ROC, PR, Confusion, Score dist)
# ============================================================
def eval_and_visualize(name, rf, X, y, thr):
    # safety check
    if X.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name}: X has {X.shape[1]} features but RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}. "
            "Make sure you use the same PCA/non-PCA features everywhere."
        )

    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    sens = tp / (tp + fn + 1e-12)   # recall for class 1
    spec = tn / (tn + fp + 1e-12)

    auc = roc_auc_score(y, prob)
    acc = accuracy_score(y, pred)
    prec = precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)
    f1 = f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)

    # ---------------- PRINT METRICS ----------------
    print("\n" + "="*65)
    print(f"{name} @ threshold = {thr:.3f}")
    print("="*65)
    print(f"AUC        : {auc:.4f}")
    print(f"Accuracy   : {acc:.4f}")
    print(f"Precision  : {prec:.4f}")
    print(f"Sensitivity: {sens:.4f}")
    print(f"Specificity: {spec:.4f}")
    print(f"F1-score   : {f1:.4f}")
    print(f"TN FP FN TP: {tn} {fp} {fn} {tp}")
    print("\nConfusion Matrix [[TN FP] [FN TP]]")
    print(cm)
    print("\nClassification Report")
    print(classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    # ---------------- PLOTS ----------------
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(18, 4))

    # 1) ROC
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    axs[0].plot(fpr, tpr)
    axs[0].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--")
    axs[0].set_title(f"{name} ROC\nAUC={auc:.3f}")
    axs[0].set_xlabel("FPR")
    axs[0].set_ylabel("TPR")

    # 2) PR
    p, r, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    axs[1].plot(r, p)
    axs[1].set_title(f"{name} PR\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("Recall")
    axs[1].set_ylabel("Precision")
    axs[1].set_xlim(0, 1)
    axs[1].set_ylim(0, 1)

    # 3) Confusion matrix
    axs[2].imshow(cm)
    axs[2].set_title("Confusion Matrix")
    axs[2].set_xticks([0, 1]); axs[2].set_yticks([0, 1])
    axs[2].set_xticklabels(["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"])
    axs[2].set_yticklabels(["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"])
    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        axs[2].text(j, i, str(v), ha="center", va="center")

    # 4) Score distribution + threshold line
    axs[3].hist(prob[y == 0], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Benign (0)")
    axs[3].hist(prob[y == 1], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant (1)")
    axs[3].axvline(thr, linestyle="--", label=f"thr={thr:.3f}")
    axs[3].set_title("Score Distribution")
    axs[3].set_xlabel("Predicted P(class=1)")
    axs[3].set_ylabel("Count")
    axs[3].legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return {
        "auc": auc, "acc": acc, "precision": prec, "sensitivity": sens,
        "specificity": spec, "f1": f1, "tn": tn, "fp": fp, "fn": fn, "tp": tp
    }

# ============================================================
# RUN (after you have thr from choose_best_threshold)
# ============================================================
val_stats  = eval_and_visualize("VAL",  rf, Xva, yva, thr)
test_stats = eval_and_visualize("TEST", rf, Xte, yte, thr)

print("\nFinal threshold used:", thr)
print("VAL stats :", val_stats)
print("TEST stats:", test_stats)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

def choose_thr_val_buffer(rf, Xva, yva, target_test_sens=0.80, buffer=0.05, grid_n=2000):
    """
    Choose threshold on VAL so that VAL sensitivity >= target_test_sens + buffer.
    Then among those thresholds, maximize specificity.
    """
    target_val_sens = min(0.99, target_test_sens + buffer)

    if Xva.shape[1] != rf.n_features_in_:
        raise ValueError(f"Feature mismatch: Xva {Xva.shape[1]} vs rf {rf.n_features_in_}")

    pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, grid_n)

    best = None
    for t in ths:
        pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
        sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
        spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

        if sens >= target_val_sens:
            if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
                best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn)}

    if best is None:
        print(f"⚠️ Could not reach VAL sens >= {target_val_sens:.2f}. Lower buffer or target.")
        # fallback: maximum sensitivity threshold
        best2 = None
        for t in ths:
            pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
            tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
            sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
            spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
            if best2 is None or sens > best2["sens"]:
                best2 = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec)}
        print("Using max-sensitivity threshold on VAL:", best2)
        return best2["t"]

    print(f"✅ Chosen threshold on VAL (buffered): target_val_sens={target_val_sens:.2f}")
    print(best)
    return best["t"]

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix,
    classification_report,
    roc_auc_score,
    roc_curve,
    accuracy_score,
    f1_score
)

def eval_and_plot(name, X, y, thr):
    probs = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred  = (probs >= thr).astype(int)

    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

    sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
    acc  = accuracy_score(y, pred)
    f1   = f1_score(y, pred)
    auc  = roc_auc_score(y, probs)

    ppv = tp/(tp+fp+1e-12)   # precision
    npv = tn/(tn+fn+1e-12)
    bal = (sens + spec)/2

    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print(f"{name} @ thr={thr:.3f}")
    print("="*50)
    print(f"AUC        : {auc:.4f}")
    print(f"Accuracy   : {acc:.4f}")
    print(f"Bal-Acc    : {bal:.4f}")
    print(f"Sensitivity: {sens:.4f}")
    print(f"Specificity: {spec:.4f}")
    print(f"PPV        : {ppv:.4f}")
    print(f"NPV        : {npv:.4f}")
    print(f"F1         : {f1:.4f}")

from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, classification_report,
    roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, precision_score,
    f1_score, roc_curve, precision_recall_curve,
    average_precision_score
)

def eval_and_plot(name, X, y, thr):
    # -----------------------
    # Predictions
    # -----------------------
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

    # -----------------------
    # PRINT METRICS
    # -----------------------
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"{name} @ thr={thr:.2f}")
    print(f"{'='*50}")

    print("AUC        :", roc_auc_score(y, prob))
    print("Accuracy   :", accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("Precision  :", precision_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Sensitivity:", sens)
    print("Specificity:", spec)
    print("F1         :", f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))

    print("\nConfusion Matrix [[TN FP] [FN TP]]:")
    print(cm)

    print("\nClassification Report:")
    print(classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))


    # -----------------------
    # PLOTS
    # -----------------------
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(1,4, figsize=(18,4))

    # ROC
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, prob)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y, prob)

    axs[0].plot(fpr, tpr)
    axs[0].plot([0,1],[0,1],'--')
    axs[0].set_title(f"{name} ROC\nAUC={auc:.3f}")
    axs[0].set_xlabel("FPR")
    axs[0].set_ylabel("TPR")


    # PR
    prec, rec, _ = precision_recall_curve(y, prob)
    ap = average_precision_score(y, prob)

    axs[1].plot(rec, prec)
    axs[1].set_title(f"{name} PR\nAP={ap:.3f}")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("Recall")
    axs[1].set_ylabel("Precision")


    # Confusion Matrix heatmap
    axs[2].imshow(cm)
    axs[2].set_title("Confusion Matrix")
    axs[2].set_xticks([0,1])
    axs[2].set_yticks([0,1])
    axs[2].set_xticklabels(["Benign","Malignant"])
    axs[2].set_yticklabels(["Benign","Malignant"])

    for (i,j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        axs[2].text(j,i,str(v),ha="center",va="center")


    # Score distribution
    axs[3].hist(prob[y==0], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Benign")
    axs[3].hist(prob[y==1], bins=25, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant")
    axs[3].axvline(thr, linestyle="--")
    axs[3].set_title("Score Distribution")
    axs[3].set_xlabel("Predicted probability")
    axs[3].legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_curve, auc,
    precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
)
from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve

def plot_side_by_side_results(model, Xva, yva, Xte, yte, thr=0.32, title="RF (Hybrid Features)"):
    # probabilities
    pva = model.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
    pte = model.predict_proba(Xte)[:, 1]

    # predictions at threshold
    pred_va = (pva >= thr).astype(int)
    pred_te = (pte >= thr).astype(int)

    # confusion matrices
    cm_va = confusion_matrix(yva, pred_va, labels=[0, 1])
    cm_te = confusion_matrix(yte, pred_te, labels=[0, 1])

    cm_va_norm = cm_va / (cm_va.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)
    cm_te_norm = cm_te / (cm_te.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)

    # ROC
    fpr_va, tpr_va, _ = roc_curve(yva, pva)
    fpr_te, tpr_te, _ = roc_curve(yte, pte)
    auc_va = auc(fpr_va, tpr_va)
    auc_te = auc(fpr_te, tpr_te)

    # PR
    prec_va, rec_va, _ = precision_recall_curve(yva, pva)
    prec_te, rec_te, _ = precision_recall_curve(yte, pte)
    ap_va = average_precision_score(yva, pva)
    ap_te = average_precision_score(yte, pte)

    # Calibration (optional but good)
    frac_pos_va, mean_pred_va = calibration_curve(yva, pva, n_bins=10, strategy="uniform")
    frac_pos_te, mean_pred_te = calibration_curve(yte, pte, n_bins=10, strategy="uniform")

    # -------------------- 1) Confusion Matrix (Counts) side by side --------------------
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    for ax, cm, name in [(axes[0], cm_va, "VAL"), (axes[1], cm_te, "TEST")]:
        im = ax.imshow(cm)
        ax.set_title(f"{title} | {name} CM (counts) @ thr={thr:.2f}")
        ax.set_xticks([0, 1]); ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
        ax.set_xticklabels(["Benign(0)", "Malignant(1)"])
        ax.set_yticklabels(["Benign(0)", "Malignant(1)"])
        ax.set_xlabel("Predicted"); ax.set_ylabel("True")
        for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
            ax.text(j, i, str(v), ha="center", va="center")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # -------------------- 2) Confusion Matrix (Normalized) side by side --------------------
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    for ax, cmn, name in [(axes[0], cm_va_norm, "VAL"), (axes[1], cm_te_norm, "TEST")]:
        im = ax.imshow(cmn, vmin=0, vmax=1)
        ax.set_title(f"{title} | {name} CM (normalized) @ thr={thr:.2f}")
        ax.set_xticks([0, 1]); ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
        ax.set_xticklabels(["Benign(0)", "Malignant(1)"])
        ax.set_yticklabels(["Benign(0)", "Malignant(1)"])
        ax.set_xlabel("Predicted"); ax.set_ylabel("True")
        for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cmn):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # -------------------- 3) ROC Curves side by side --------------------
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    axes[0].plot(fpr_va, tpr_va, label=f"AUC={auc_va:.4f}")
    axes[0].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--")
    axes[0].set_title(f"{title} | VAL ROC")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("FPR (1 - Specificity)")
    axes[0].set_ylabel("TPR (Sensitivity)")
    axes[0].legend(loc="lower right")

    axes[1].plot(fpr_te, tpr_te, label=f"AUC={auc_te:.4f}")
    axes[1].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--")
    axes[1].set_title(f"{title} | TEST ROC")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("FPR (1 - Specificity)")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("TPR (Sensitivity)")
    axes[1].legend(loc="lower right")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # -------------------- 4) PR Curves side by side --------------------
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    axes[0].plot(rec_va, prec_va, label=f"AP={ap_va:.4f}")
    axes[0].set_title(f"{title} | VAL Precision–Recall")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("Recall (Sensitivity)")
    axes[0].set_ylabel("Precision (PPV)")
    axes[0].legend(loc="lower left")

    axes[1].plot(rec_te, prec_te, label=f"AP={ap_te:.4f}")
    axes[1].set_title(f"{title} | TEST Precision–Recall")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Recall (Sensitivity)")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Precision (PPV)")
    axes[1].legend(loc="lower left")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # -------------------- 5) Score distribution (VAL vs TEST) side by side --------------------
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    for ax, probs, y, name in [(axes[0], pva, yva, "VAL"), (axes[1], pte, yte, "TEST")]:
        ax.hist(probs[y == 0], bins=30, alpha=0.7, label="Benign(0)")
        ax.hist(probs[y == 1], bins=30, alpha=0.7, label="Malignant(1)")
        ax.axvline(thr, linestyle="--", label=f"thr={thr:.2f}")
        ax.set_title(f"{title} | {name} Probabilities")
        ax.set_xlabel("Predicted P(malignant)")
        ax.set_ylabel("Count")
        ax.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # -------------------- 6) Calibration curve side by side --------------------
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
    axes[0].plot(mean_pred_va, frac_pos_va, marker="o", label="Model")
    axes[0].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--", label="Perfect")
    axes[0].set_title(f"{title} | VAL Calibration")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("Mean predicted probability")
    axes[0].set_ylabel("Fraction of positives")
    axes[0].legend()

    axes[1].plot(mean_pred_te, frac_pos_te, marker="o", label="Model")
    axes[1].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--", label="Perfect")
    axes[1].set_title(f"{title} | TEST Calibration")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Mean predicted probability")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Fraction of positives")
    axes[1].legend()

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # Return probabilities too (handy if you want more plots later)
    return pva, pte


# --------- USE IT ----------
# If you want to force 0.32:
thr = 0.32

# Or if you used your sensitivity-target threshold:
# thr = best["t"]

pva, pte = plot_side_by_side_results(rf, Xva, yva, Xte, yte, thr=thr, title="Hybrid CNN+ViT+CLIP → RF")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay,
    roc_auc_score, accuracy_score, balanced_accuracy_score,
    precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, classification_report
)

# pick threshold by max Youden J on VAL
pva = rf.predict_proba(Xva)[:, 1]
ths = np.linspace(0.05, 0.95, 181)

best = None
for t in ths:
    pred = (pva >= t).astype(int)
    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yva, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()
    sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
    j = sens + spec - 1
    if best is None or j > best["j"]:
        best = {"t": float(t), "sens": float(sens), "spec": float(spec), "j": float(j)}

print("Best threshold (VAL):", best)
thr = best["t"]

def eval_and_plot(name, X, y, thr):
    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
    ppv  = tp/(tp+fp+1e-12)
    npv  = tn/(tn+fn+1e-12)

    print(f"\n== {name} @ thr={thr:.2f} ==")
    print("AUC        :", roc_auc_score(y, prob))
    print("Accuracy   :", accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("Bal-Acc    :", balanced_accuracy_score(y, pred))
    print("Sensitivity:", sens)
    print("Specificity:", spec)
    print("PPV (Prec) :", ppv)
    print("NPV        :", npv)
    print("F1         :", f1_score(y, pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Confusion Matrix [ [TN FP] [FN TP] ]:\n", cm)
    print("\nClassification Report:\n", classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))

    # confusion matrix square box
    disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=["Benign(0)", "Malignant(1)"])
    plt.figure()
    disp.plot(values_format="d")
    plt.title(f"{name} Confusion Matrix (thr={thr:.2f})")
    plt.show()

eval_and_plot("VAL",  Xva, yva, thr)
eval_and_plot("TEST", Xte, yte, thr)

from sklearn.metrics import (
    confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score, accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    f1_score, classification_report
)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import ConfusionMatrixDisplay


# =====================================================
# 🔒 FINAL THRESHOLD (LOCKED)
# =====================================================
thr = 0.41
print("FINAL threshold locked at:", thr)


def evaluate(name, X, y):

    prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    pred = (prob >= thr).astype(int)

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, pred, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()

    sensitivity = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
    specificity = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)
    ppv = tp/(tp+fp+1e-12)
    npv = tn/(tn+fn+1e-12)

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print(f"{name} RESULTS  (threshold = 0.41)")
    print("="*60)

    print("AUC        :", round(roc_auc_score(y, prob),4))
    print("Accuracy   :", round(accuracy_score(y, pred),4))
    print("Bal-Acc    :", round(balanced_accuracy_score(y, pred),4))
    print("Sensitivity:", round(sensitivity,4), "(malignant recall)")
    print("Specificity:", round(specificity,4), "(benign recall)")
    print("PPV        :", round(ppv,4))
    print("NPV        :", round(npv,4))
    print("F1-score   :", round(f1_score(y, pred),4))

    print("\nConfusion Matrix  [[TN FP] [FN TP]]")
    print(cm)

    print("\nClassification Report:\n")
    print(classification_report(y, pred, digits=4))


    # pretty confusion matrix
    disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(cm, display_labels=["Benign(0)", "Malignant(1)"])
    plt.figure()
    disp.plot(values_format="d")
    plt.title(f"{name} Confusion Matrix (thr=0.41)")
    plt.show()


# =====================================================
# FINAL RESULTS
# =====================================================
evaluate("VALIDATION", Xva, yva)
evaluate("TEST", Xte, yte)

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix

def find_best_threshold(rf, Xval, yval, target_sens=0.80):
    """
    Choose threshold that:
    1) achieves sensitivity >= target_sens
    2) among them maximizes specificity
    """

    # safety check (prevents your previous error)
    assert Xval.shape[1] == rf.n_features_in_, \
        f"Feature mismatch: X has {Xval.shape[1]}, RF expects {rf.n_features_in_}"

    prob = rf.predict_proba(Xval)[:, 1]

    ths = np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, 991)
    best = None

    for t in ths:
        pred = (prob >= t).astype(int)

        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(yval, pred, labels=[0,1]).ravel()

        sens = tp/(tp+fn+1e-12)
        spec = tn/(tn+fp+1e-12)

        if sens >= target_sens:
            if best is None or spec > best["spec"]:
                best = {
                    "threshold": float(t),
                    "sens": float(sens),
                    "spec": float(spec),
                    "fp": int(fp),
                    "fn": int(fn)
                }

    # fallback if not reachable
    if best is None:
        print("⚠️ Target sensitivity not reachable. Using default 0.5")
        return 0.5

    print("\n✅ Best threshold found:")
    print(best)

    return best["threshold"]
